sentences.en: I was determined to fulfill my duties at any cost.
sentences.zh: 我决心不惜一切代价完成我的职责。

sentences.en: Have you determined whom you will invite to the party?
sentences.zh: 你决定邀请谁参加派对了吗？

sentences.en: He was determined to finish the work at any cost.
sentences.zh: 他决心不惜一切代价完成这项工作。

senses.zh: 决定，确定；判定，判决；限定
确定；决定；判决，终止；[主用于法律]了结，终止，结束

mnemonic: 词根记忆：de（加强）+termin（边界）+ e→加强界限→确定
